_about: The stand-in agent for proving the dock's shapes (fixtures/fake_agent.py). Its one argument is the fresh fixture's card for the garden gate, so the commitment it drafts names a real card. A real home's agents file lives at <HQ>/agents.json; the row's command starts the player's own agent over the Agent Client Protocol. A row's `character` is who the agent is here, sent to it as its first system-style context; absent, the kit's default is sent (agent_host.py DEFAULT_CHARACTER).
